strips.title: A day of actually drinking water — with the Owala FreeSip

panels.head: 9 AM — at the desk
panels.text: Straw mode. Sip without tipping, no spills on the keyboard, still ice-cold.

panels.head: Noon — in the car
panels.text: The 24 oz fits the cup holder. One thumb on the button, eyes on the road.

panels.head: 6 PM — after the workout
panels.text: Tilt further and chug through the wide spout. Lock it, drop it in the bag.

panels.head: Sunday — two-minute reset
panels.text: Pull the gasket, top-rack the lid and straw. Ice-cold again on Monday.
